Private parties

Graduations, weddings, rehearsal dinners, anniversaries, bachelor and bachelorette parties, birthdays, sweet sixteens, turning twenty-one. Pick your favourites off the regular menu and we'll type up a special menu for you and your guests, or choose from the party menu below.

The staff takes great pride in preparing all the food for your function. If you'd like to request a favourite item that isn't listed, just ask.
